what: HIGH (code audit CA-A06, MEASURED 2026-09-27): the Phase H decision push-back subsystem (src/runtime/decision_push.py + its repo half scripts/ops/push_decisions_back.py) has been silently unable to see ANY decision request since the 2026-09-21 operating reset, because its source directory docs/claude/work/objects/ -- the 'work object' store `decision_requests[]` lived on -- was archived by that reset (CLAUDE.md: 'Retired 2026-09-21 ... the work store (docs/claude/work/objects|intents|steps/) ... Do not resurrect them'). REPRODUCED: `python3 scripts/ops/push_decisions_back.py --queue` prints 'push_decisions_back — queue depth 0' with all five action counts at 0 and the closing line 'Nothing to push. Record the empty run with --receipt so nothing to do stays distinguishable from the drain died' -- but the receipt mechanism CANNOT make that distinction here: scripts/ops/push_decisions_back.py::_iter_objects() (line ~108) does `if not OBJECTS_DIR.exists(): return out` before the glob, so 'the store was retired out from under this reader' and 'the store is healthy and genuinely has nothing pending' both render as the exact same queue depth 0 / empty receipt. This is the same defect class MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json row E29 already found and named for a different pair (board_pointer.py / reconcile_open_prs.py): 'the reset disarmed every workflow that WRITES to a retired register and swept none of the ones that READ one.' This pair (work_decisions.py / decision_push.py / push_decisions_back.py / blocked_lane_watch.py / commit_work_decisions.py / the CI guard scripts/ci/check_decision_answers.py) was not covered by that sweep. Contrast: scripts/ci/check_decision_answers.py IS correctly guarded -- it does `if not OBJECTS.is_dir(): return 1` in main() and was VERIFIED BY DIRECT EXECUTION to fail loud (real exit code 1, confirmed via separate `echo $?` after redirecting to a file rather than piping through `tail`, which would have masked it) -- and scripts/ops/render_due_list.py's spent-decision-edges source also correctly checks `.is_dir()` first and reports `not_applicable`. Only the push-back drain's own reader lacks the same guard. SEPARATELY, src/runtime/decision_push.py::render_push_message still hard-codes 'Truth of record: docs/claude/work/objects/{object_id}.yaml' in the text it would push into a woken session -- a path that no longer exists -- though this half is currently latent since the queue is always empty. POPULATION: n=1 subsystem (Phase H decision push-back); the objects directory itself has 0 files (confirmed: `ls docs/claude/work/objects` -> No such file or directory). BLAST RADIUS today is most likely 'orphaned, nobody currently files decision_requests via this path any more' (the live API in src/web/api/routers/work.py has already been correctly updated to read the new MANAGER-CHECKLIST/pipeline model instead) rather than 'actively losing a delivered decision' -- but that is inferred, not measured: nobody has checked whether any workflow or session still writes a decision_requests[] block anywhere. Full finding + repro commands: docs/audits/code-audit-2026-09-27/CA-A06.findings.jsonl id CA-A06-001.
